decisions.reason: The source changes compatibility rules for 3D-model reference paths, not resolution of the L1 footprint library.
KiCad 3D-model path-variable compatibility does not change the required content of the sensor-board BOM.
The source does not change legacy main-board BOM completeness, part availability, or optional connector population.
The source concerns 3D-model references in KiCad 9 and does not alter power-board BOM assembly requirements.
The requirement to provide the latest integrated-board package for quotation remains unchanged by the 3D-model path rule.
KiCad version compatibility for 3D-model references does not change the integrated design's cost, architecture, connector, or component-selection policies.
The source does not change the required sensor-board fabrication, drill, or placement exports.
The KiCad 3D-model path-variable decision has no effect on the QR-code marking requirement.
The source does not modify the selected through-hole connector assembly style or its coverage.
The integrated-board BOM remains complete and suitable for quotation regardless of the separate 3D-model reference compatibility issue.
The source does not change the requirement for lead-free board production.
The 3D-model path-variable compatibility rule does not resolve or alter connector pin markings.
